system.description:
When you make a Focused Attack you choose which type of attack you will make and gain the corresponding effect. These are referred to as FBA attacks.

  • Light: Gain +1 to your attack roll and lose -1 base damage on this attack.
  • Heavy: Deal +1 base damage and lose -1 to this attacks attack roll.
  • Grab: On hit, you automatically grapple the target. This grapple uses the same limitations as the Grapple action.

All grapples made from Striker Skills can be maintained with a single hand.
